blocks.title: Key vocabulary
items: event handler — Code invoked by event.
textContent — Text stored in a DOM node.

blocks.title: Understand
blocks.text: CSS controls presentation using selectors and declarations; `#status` targets one element by id.

blocks.title: Trace
blocks.text: JavaScript can react to browser events and modify the DOM. The handler does not execute until a click event occurs.

blocks.title: Evaluate
blocks.text: The document's structure remains HTML, styles remain CSS, and interactive behaviour is JavaScript. Validate incoming data on the server even if scripts check it first.

blocks.title: Worked example · Predict first
blocks.text: Start with count=0; first click handler adds one making count=1.

blocks.title: Worked example · Show method
blocks.text: Second click adds one again giving count=2; no change happens before an event.

blocks.title: Predict first
blocks.text: getElementById selects the existing paragraph whose id is 'msg'.

blocks.title: Show method
blocks.text: Assigning textContent replaces displayed text with 'On'; it is safer for text than injecting untrusted HTML.
